messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need to migrate the per-route quota_window from an int (hours) to a polymorphic object so it can express rolling windows + business-days. dashboards currently assume int and some queries break when window > 24h.
kevin: ugh, yeah saw some p99 spikes in console queries when the new routes landed. is this just a read-adapter issue or do we need a backfill?
olga: It's both. storage shape change means indexes need adjustment and the materialized views for the billing dashboard expect a numeric field. If we dual-write we can avoid downtime but queries will still error until the view is patched.
sam: +1 dual-write. also we should gate the new shape behind a feature flag and use a canary route set. we can route 5% of traffic and monitor console latency, p50/p95, and billing ingest lag.
maya: proposed migration plan: 1) introduce new column quota_window_v2 jsonb (nullable) 2) app dual-write route updates to v1+v2 for 2 weeks 3) backfill v2 for existing rows with safe translation 4) swap views and fix dashboards 5) drop v1 after 30d. Thoughts?
kevin: sounds reasonable. need to be explicit about queries that read numeric vs object. I can add a compatibility layer in the SQL view: `coalesce(quota_window_v2->>'hours', quota_window_v1::text)` for the dashboards. but that will be slow for large scans.
olga: for billing runs we should precompute a normalized_window column (intish) for heavy queries and keep v2 for config + UI. normalized_window will be updated on dual-write and backfill. this keeps heavy analytics fast.
maya: good call. we should also add a migration metric emitted to telemetry: `quota_window_migration_status` with labels (route_id, status). deploy-bot: deploy queued: schema-migration-tool v3.2 -> staging.
sam: can we avoid a full table scan? use incremental backfill by last_updated window and parallel workers. set safe rate limits so we don't swamp db.
kevin: agree. also need to update the route-rollout API contract: consumers that accept an int must be versioned. propose `PATCH /routes/:id` accepts either `quota_window` (legacy int) or `quota_window_v2` object; server normalizes to v2. add header `X-Route-Contract: v2` for clients opting in.
maya: ok update scheduled. last action: olga, can you update billing view PR and add a follow-up to the dashboard team to QA widgets? olga: on it, will add a canary dashboard showing both old & new metrics side-by-side.
kevin: rollout timeline? propose: staging canary tomorrow, 5% prod next Wed, 50% two days later, full by EOW if metrics stable.
sam: add rollback plan: if error rate > 1% or billing mismatch > 0.5% trigger autoswitch to v1-only route and pause backfill.
maya: agreed. I'll open the runbook and add step-by-step commands, and add `schemamig:quotawindow` tag to the PRs. thanks all :thumbsup:
